title: Russian earthquake weapons could set off an earthquake at Yellowstone

tellings.quote: The Russians have earthquake weapons. They can cause an earthquake at Yellowstone that'll wipe out the center US.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the Russians have earthquake weapons. He says they could set off an earthquake at Yellowstone, a huge volcanic park in the western United States, that would wipe out the middle of the country. If true, it would mean a hidden weapon able to devastate a nation without a single bomb.
